items.headline: UOB Q3 net profit misses analyst forecasts amid weaker trading income and margin pressure
items.summary: <cite index="1-5">UOB reported third-quarter net profit of S$1.25 billion, below the Bloomberg consensus estimate of around S$1.37 billion, representing a shortfall of about 9%</cite>. <cite index="1-4">Shares dropped 5.4% to S$38.27, falling to their lowest level since June 16</cite>.

items.headline: Singtel, NUHS, and Ericsson expand partnership to advance 6G AI healthcare
items.summary: <cite index="11-1">The National University Health System (NUHS), Singtel and Ericsson signed a Memorandum of Understanding to advance connected healthcare, 5G-Advanced and 6G technology, as well as connected intelligence</cite>. <cite index="10-2">The NXAC will be the world's first 6G AI centre dedicated to healthcare</cite>.

items.headline: Nvidia reclaims world's most valuable company title from Apple on election day
items.summary: <cite index="22-1">Nvidia reclaimed the top spot on Election Day, rising 2% to a $4.99 trillion market cap while Apple slipped to $4.84 trillion</cite>. <cite index="22-2">Surging AI demand lifted one tech giant back to the top of the market cap rankings on Election Day</cite>.

items.headline: Data center developers face tighter regulatory headwinds after Democratic election sweep
items.summary: <cite index="30-4">In gubernatorial races in Texas and Georgia, Democrats who campaigned in part on a moratorium on data centre development won offices that the party had not held for decades</cite>. <cite index="30-6">Texas accounts for about a quarter of US data-centre capacity due to come online by 2030</cite>.

items.headline: Elon Musk's election gamble backfires amid Democratic sweep in Texas
items.summary: <cite index="40-7,40-8">Democrats' sweeping midterms victory marked a major rejection of Elon Musk and the artificial-intelligence industry; Musk spent a record of at least $474 million on the midterms, funneling $224 million into Texas alone</cite>. <cite index="40-6">The results could create new political obstacles in Texas, where Tesla, SpaceX and other Musk ventures have major operations</cite>.
